chapter_seo_title: Spirit-Blight vs. Li Huowang: A Desperate Burning Battleground
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang hunts a sly, invisible Spirit-Blight. He burns the forest, is possessed, melts, and uses his own severed leg as a trap. A masterclass in tactical body horror.
og_title: He Used His Own Leg as a Decoy!
og_description: An invisible, sin-eating entity forces Li Huowang to set himself on fire and sacrifice his own lower half. Read the grotesque, tactical showdown.
twitter_title: Li Huowang's genius trap: his own severed leg!
twitter_description: The Spirit-Blight can't be seen by humans. Li Huowang's solution? Bait it with his own cooked leg. This is horror xianxia at its finest.

lore_anchors.definition: An entity born from pure sin or negative karma. It has no physical form and is completely invisible to any being that still possesses the ‘Ten Emotions and Eight Sufferings.’ It corrupts and assimilates its host’s body and consciousness.

A twisted Xianxia concept of the fundamental emotional and karmic burdens that define a living being. Possessing these traits makes a human blind to Spirit-Blights, but losing them is a terrifying transformation in itself.
A grotesque parasitic entity that excels at possession and reshaping its physical form. Li Sui, who is a Black Tai Sui, fights by disassembling her body into a mass of tentacles and flesh.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Li Huowang see the Spirit-Blight?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Spirit-Blight is invisible to anyone who still carries the 'Ten Emotions and Eight Sufferings,' which means any living, feeling human. He can only track its footprints in the ash.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How does Li Huowang's trap work in the end?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He uses his “Cultivate the False into Reality” ability to separate his lower body from his upper body. The Spirit-Blight, thinking it’s hiding inside a living leg, burrows into the detached, dead half, trapping itself.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Spirit-Blight a monster or a curse?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s more like an embodiment of sin or negative karma. It doesn't have a natural body of its own; it's a pure, malevolent force that seeks to corrupt and assimilate whatever it possesses.
